salaryAnalysis.summary: Salary data is highly variable due to currency differences (USD, CAD, and unspecified $) and role types, ranging from hourly/stipend-based intern pay to six-figure annual professional salaries.

educationPatterns: Pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
Enrolled in a recognized post-secondary co-op program

remoteWork.summary: The market offers a variety of work models, ranging from fully in-person or office-based roles to hybrid and primarily remote options.

marketInsights: Internship and Co-op roles are prominent, particularly in specialized fields like Robotics and AI.
There is a strong demand for cloud technologies (AWS) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) across various seniority levels.
Machine Learning and Generative AI skills are emerging as key requirements for specialized engineering roles.
The market shows a mix of large enterprise roles (Amazon, Magna) and highly specialized small AI/Robotics startups.
